title: Psalm 114
opening_line: When Isr’el out of Egypt went,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: When Isr’el out of Egypt went,
text.normalized: When Isr’el out of Egypt went,
text.reading: When Isr’el out of Egypt went,

text.diplomatic: and did his dwelling change,
text.normalized: And did his dwelling change,
text.reading: and did his dwelling change,

text.diplomatic: When Jacob’s house went out from those
text.normalized: When Jacob’s house went out from those
text.reading: When Jacob’s house went out from those

text.diplomatic: that were of language strange,
text.normalized: That were of language strange,
text.reading: that were of language strange,

text.diplomatic: He Judah did his sanctuary,
text.normalized: He Judah did his sanctuary,
text.reading: He Judah did his sanctuary,

text.diplomatic: his kingdom Isr’el make:
text.normalized: His kingdom Isr’el make:
text.reading: his kingdom Isr’el make:

text.diplomatic: The sea it saw, and quickly fled,
text.normalized: The sea it saw, and quickly fled,
text.reading: The sea it saw, and quickly fled,

text.diplomatic: Jordan was driven back.
text.normalized: Jordan was driven back.
text.reading: Jordan was driven back.

text.diplomatic: Like rams the mountains, and like lambs
text.normalized: Like rams the mountains, and like lambs
text.reading: Like rams the mountains, and like lambs

text.diplomatic: the hills skipped to and fro.
text.normalized: The hills skipped to and fro.
text.reading: the hills skipped to and fro.

text.diplomatic: O sea, why fledd’st thou? Jordan, back
text.normalized: O sea, why fledd’st thou? Jordan, back
text.reading: O sea, why fledd’st thou? Jordan, back

text.diplomatic: why wast thou driven so?
text.normalized: Why wast thou driven so?
text.reading: why wast thou driven so?

text.diplomatic: Ye mountains great, wherefore was it
text.normalized: Ye mountains great, wherefore was it
text.reading: Ye mountains great, wherefore was it

text.diplomatic: that ye did skip like rams?
text.normalized: That ye did skip like rams?
text.reading: that ye did skip like rams?

text.diplomatic: And wherefore was it, little hills,
text.normalized: And wherefore was it, little hills,
text.reading: And wherefore was it, little hills,

text.diplomatic: that ye did leap like lambs?
text.normalized: That ye did leap like lambs?
text.reading: that ye did leap like lambs?

text.diplomatic: O at the presence of the Lord,
text.normalized: O at the presence of the Lord,
text.reading: O at the presence of the Lord,

text.diplomatic: earth, tremble thou for fear,
text.normalized: Earth, tremble thou for fear,
text.reading: earth, tremble thou for fear,

text.diplomatic: While as the presence of the God
text.normalized: While as the presence of the God
text.reading: While as the presence of the God

text.diplomatic: of Jacob doth appear:
text.normalized: Of Jacob doth appear:
text.reading: of Jacob doth appear:

text.diplomatic: Who from the hard and stony rock
text.normalized: Who from the hard and stony rock
text.reading: Who from the hard and stony rock

text.diplomatic: did standing water bring;
text.normalized: Did standing water bring;
text.reading: did standing water bring;

text.diplomatic: And by his pow’r did turn the flint
text.normalized: And by his pow’r did turn the flint
text.reading: And by his pow’r did turn the flint

text.diplomatic: into a water-spring.
text.normalized: Into a water-spring.
text.reading: into a water-spring.
